summary: Run sheets for BW01_0059 (Quorenthel Pharma GmbH, QP07 aminopyrazine series 07): plate acceptance, primary kinase IC50 for all 24 compounds and the 16-kinase selectivity sweep at 1 µM on six of them. Accepted 18 May 2001 after the interim read on 27 April.

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: BW01_0059 run sheets: QP07 metabolic kinase potency and selectivity

rows: The primary potency ranking survived the selectivity counterscreen, and Quorenthel progressed the compact heteroaryl subset.

comments.text: Series count matches the quote. Panel was run on six compounds only, not the full set.
comments.author: Ines Alvarado

sheets.name: Plate acceptance
rows: Edge wells excluded, as per study plan
Acceptance criteria as per study plan. Plates were not accepted on a single control alone; both the reference and the vehicle well had to be in range.

rows.v: Plate acceptance: all three plates accepted for the final fit.

comments.text: Edge exclusion is the standard for this format, not a deviation. Recorded so the next reader does not query it.
comments.author: Martin Ellerscombe

sheets.name: Primary IC50

rows.v: Primary potency assay: 10-point concentration response, ATP at Km

rows: Replicate fits are on the run sheet. Hill slopes outside 0.7 to 1.5 were re-fitted with the top fixed at 100% before the value was accepted.

sheets.name: Selectivity

rows.v: Selectivity sweep: % inhibition at 1 µM, six representative compounds

rows: Selected for the sweep on the basis of primary potency and the compact heteroaryl subset. Readings above 50% flagged for follow-up.

comments.text: Single-point only. Any kinase above 50% needs a concentration response before we say anything about it.
comments.author: Ravi Deshmukh
